subject: Update supported version list. (#12488)
reason: Documentation-only change: it updates the supported-version table in SECURITY.md, normalizes unicode apostrophes to ASCII in SECURITY.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, fixes a comment in tests/integration/psync2-master-restart.tcl, and changes the same apostrophe character in two test-only string literals in tests/modules/infotest.c (output only in a crash-report INFO section of a test module). No server code, command behaviour, replies, replication, persistence or configuration is touched, so there is no changed behaviour for a scenario to reach.
